tools.name: describe_data
tools.description: Start here. Every table and view: description, period, rows, tool to use, warnings, and the last complete production month. With tablas, also their columns. Example: {tablas: ['pozos']}.

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description: Free text → exact names for filters (companies, areas, fields, formations, basins, provinces, wells), with context and last month with production. Example: {texto: 'palmar', tipo: 'yacimiento'}.

tools.name: query_production
tools.description: Oil, gas and water production (2006–present) by entity and period, grouped by up to 3 dimensions: volumes, BOE, producing/reporting wells, daily rate, GOR, water cut. Example: {area_concesion: "LOMA CAMPANA", fecha_desde: "2025", agrupar_por: ["anio"]}.

tools.name: query_wells
tools.description: Wells in the registry (~86,000): location, type, current status and operator, cumulative production, first and last month with production, IP30. Example: {provincia: 'Neuquén', subtipo_recurso: 'SHALE', tipo_estado: 'activos'}.

tools.name: get_well
tools.description: One well by idpozo or sigla: registry data, IP30/90/180, cumulative volumes, recent GOR and water cut, last 36 months of production, fracture jobs and trajectory. Example: {sigla: 'YPF.Nq.LCa-1001(h)'}.

tools.name: get_area
tools.description: One concession area: 12-month production and year-on-year change, operators and shares, wells by type and state, top wells and the last 24 months. Example: {area_concesion: 'LOMA CAMPANA'}.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One operator: 12-month production, national share, year-on-year change, areas, basins, wells, investments, reserves and, if listed, share price and SEC financials. Example: {empresa: 'VISTA ENERGY ARGENTINA SAU'}.

tools.name: rank_entities
tools.description: Top N wells, areas, companies, fields, basins or formations by production, BOE, GOR, water cut, growth, new wells or IP30/90/180 (raw, per meter, per stage). Example: {entidad: 'pozo', metrica: 'ip30', subtipo_recurso: 'SHALE', tipo_pozo: 'Petrolífero', fecha_desde: '2025', fecha_hasta: '2025'}.

tools.name: query_completions
tools.description: Fracture jobs by year, company (the one that reported the job), area, formation or well: wells, stages, stages per well, lateral length, proppant, water. Example: {formacion: 'vaca muerta', fecha_desde: '2025', agrupar_por: ['empresa']}.

tools.name: query_reserves
tools.description: P1/P2/P3 oil and gas reserves at Dec 31 by year, basin, company and resource type (end of useful life); oil and gas in separate columns. Default: latest year. Example: {anio: [2024], agrupar_por: ['cuenca'], categorias: ['P1']}.

tools.name: query_investments
tools.description: Upstream oil & gas investments in Argentina by company, basin, year and concept, in millions of USD (drilling, workovers, pipelines, facilities, seismic…). Example: {cuenca: 'NEUQUINA', anio_desde: 2023, concepto: 'perforacion'}.

tools.name: query_prices
tools.description: International and local energy prices: WTI, Brent, Henry Hub (daily, USD), Argentine crude price used for royalties by province (monthly, USD/bbl) and ARS/USD exchange rates (daily). Most recent first. Example: {serie: 'BRENT', fecha_desde: '2024', frecuencia: 'mensual'}.

tools.name: query_trade
tools.description: Argentina hydrocarbon exports and imports by month: crude oil (HS 2709), refined products (HS 2710) and natural gas (HS 2711), FOB USD and kg. Example: {anio: 2025, flow: 'export', producto: 'crude'}.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Run read-only DuckDB SQL (a single SELECT or WITH) over the catalog tables and views. Prefer the curated tools when they fit; call describe_data first for tables and columns. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "query_production" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
